title: DAPK1 Ablation Promotes Wound Healing by Keratinocyte Modulation
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Death-associated protein kinase 1 (DAPK1), a Ca²+/calmodulin-regulated serine/threonine kinase, plays a pivotal role in epidermal homeostasis, tissue repair, and cutaneous wound healing. However, its role in oral mucosal repair remains unclear. In this ...
